title: BJ Green, Zach Durfee Headline Jaguars’ Mock Scrimmage

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: BJ Green, Zach Durfee Headline Jaguars’ Mock Scrimmage
sources.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars held their annual mock scrimmage on Day 8 of training camp, with B.J. Green II producing the most dominant individual defensive performance of the offseason. Here's everything you need to know from the 2026 Teal and White scrimmage.
